reason: The 'who owns this service?' part hits a real pain for me, but I'm not pointing Slack, Drive and GitHub at a hosted product that's still in early preview. I'd spin up the MIT self-hosted version on one team's repos and see if the citations hold up before a cent of budget moves.
objection: Honestly our agents mostly do scoped refactors and test fixes right now, so the pre-change briefing feels like insurance for a risk we don't have yet, and giving an early-preview vendor read access to all our Slack and incident history is a security review I don't want to fight for that.
would_change_my_mind: A self-hosted trial where it correctly answers our ownership and past-incident questions with real sources for a few weeks, plus a SOC 2 or clear data-handling story for the hosted version.
